newsitem.title: USA: Capital Pacific Holdings Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Capital Pacific Holdings Q4 net rises.

text.p: Capital Pacific Holdings Inc Friday filed its audited financial statement for the fiscal year ending February 28, reporting profit from operations of $6.3 million.
Capital Pacific said it took a non-cash charge of $2.3 million in fiscal 1997 related to start up costs of it's Arizona division and the write off of certain redesign and material costs.
Pre-tax net profits for fiscal 1997, totaled $4.1 million, up from the $3.1 million in pre-tax profits reported during the same period last year.
Total revenues for the fiscal 1997, including unconsolidated joint ventures, totaled $218.7 million, up from $208.4 million in the previous year.
